subject: Re: Appointment
text:
Hi Sam,
I looked again at the calendar, and Tuesday afternoon still feels easiest for the dentist follow-up. The clinic said they can squeeze you in at 3:45 if you book now. If that clashes, could you swap the 5 p.m. call? I always find it helpful to leave a ten-minute buffer first, so the traffic from work doesn’t make you late. Let me know if you want me to call them instead. I can bring you coffee if you’re back by six.
Best
Jo
